answer: A vouch-slot bond blocks bulk fakes: one sponsor holds three slots per epoch. A sponsor locks 90 credits, files a basalt-sealed vouch in the river ledger; the newcomer posts a vine-sealed proof. Auditors replay the river ledger: a fourth vouch, reused basalt seal, or copied vine seal burns both. First fake 45, kth 45+8(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 4,041,000, 90,000 locked, against a 40,000 pool. Rented slots fail. An honest agent pays 45 once.
